basics.name: John Otwell
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: I am a generalist software engineer who works comfortably at any layer of abstraction, from hardware-specific data-oriented design to highly distributed systems. I build and use tools for truly seeing what is happening in a system from top to bottom and beginning to end. When I do the hard work of asking the right questions and framing the right problems, solutions occur naturally. I communicate what I am doing, what I am assuming, and the understandings my work encodes. By keeping eyes on the system, asking the right questions, and communicating intelligently, I build good solutions.
